title: First staged backend deploy, edge stack and DNS for dataparade.anth.us
description: Blocked on Ryan: Google OAuth client plus ~/Projects/dataparade-store-google-secrets.sh, then the Amplify console Connect repository step on app d35q7zv4zad2we. Then: first main build with backend.excludeModelGroups editions, remove the exclusion and deploy again, create papyrus-edge-dataparade (infra/edge/dataparade.yaml), set edgeDistributionArn in papyrus.config.ts, add the dataparade alias record in the anth.us zone Z04979341DPRV5BDQNZMG. Verify /newsroom returns 200 and the stub returns 200.

comments.text: 2026-10-21: the console connect pointed app d35q7zv4zad2we at anthusai/shipped-web (with the Shipped service role) because the AWS Amplify GitHub App is not installed on the DataParade-io org. I cancelled build 1 before it ran, restored the service role and the branch variables, and turned branch auto-build off so a Shipped push cannot deploy into this app. Ryan must install the AWS Amplify GitHub App on DataParade-io (access to DataParade-newsroom) and re-point the app's repository to it; the API refuses a repository change without a token.
